description: Defines an abstract class for a read-only Drupal stream wrapper for local files, implementing methods to handle file operations such as open, lock, write, flush, metadata, truncate, unlink, rename, mkdir, and rmdir in a read-only context.

classes.name: LocalReadOnlyStream
classes.description: An abstract class extending LocalStream, providing read-only stream wrapper functionality for local files in Drupal.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of stream wrapper, combining READ_VISIBLE and LOCAL flags.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream if mode is read-only ('r', 'rb', 'rt'), otherwise triggers a warning.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Handles flock() locking; disallows exclusive locks and non-blocking locks, allows shared and unlock locks.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns FALSE, as writing is not supported in read-only stream.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: Returns FALSE, as no data is written in a read-only stream.

methods.name: stream_metadata
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns FALSE; metadata changes are not supported.

methods.name: stream_truncate
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns FALSE; truncation is not supported.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns TRUE; files cannot be deleted in read-only mode.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns FALSE; renaming is not supported.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns FALSE; directory creation is not supported.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Triggers a warning and returns FALSE; directory deletion is not supported.
